newsitem.title: ITALY: Several killed in blaze on Italian methane tanker.
newsitem.headline: Several killed in blaze on Italian methane tanker.

text.p: Several crew were killed on Wednesday when fire broke out on a new methane tanker undergoing sea trials off the northern port of Genoa, fire officials said.
A spokesman said the number of dead was still unclear. "It could be three or it could be six or seven," he said.
The spokesman said a fire had broken out in the engine room at about 0415 GMT. The cause of the blaze was not known.
Firefighters from Genoa went out by helicopter and were winched on board the SNAM Portovenere, some 15 miles south of Genoa. The blaze was now under control, the spokesman said.
Injured engineers and other workers involved in the trials were being ferried by helicopter to three hospitals in the area.
The ship, which was empty, was being tested ahead of delivery to SNAM, a unit of state energy group ENI, the company said.
